description: Represents a file or folder in TmDocumentManager{TMetadata}.

members.name: Attachments
members.description: Physical file attachments linked to this item.

members.name: Extension
members.description: File extension including the dot (e.g. ".pdf"). Empty for folders.

members.name: IconName
members.description: Optional icon override (name from the icon registry).

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable unique identifier. Used as the primary key for all operations.

members.name: IsDirectory
members.description: Whether this item is a folder.

members.name: ModifiedBy
members.description: User who last modified the item.

members.name: Name
members.description: Display name (file name or folder name).

members.name: Path
members.description: Full path for display and breadcrumb purposes only. Not used as an identifier.

members.name: Permissions
members.description: Access permissions for the current user.

members.name: Size
members.description: File size in bytes. Null for folders.
